messages:
marta_cs: Morning team — Rally 'primeburst' dedicated bring-up. Need final alignment on quota slots, autoscale floor, and fallback plan for Wed 09:00 PT. Can we lock?
ash_serving: Wed 09 PT works for me. Proposed quota: 120k monthly tokens reservation, burst window 90m, per-pool concurrency 64.
raj_sre: locking time. Need a brief maintenance window? Router change might be required. Prefer 08:45-10:00 so we can rollback if needed.
emma_eng: plan for two phases: 200rps smoke (10m) to validate priming, then sweep up to 600rps (20m). We'll do a 5m warm cache step before the sweep.
marta_cs: good. We also need a clear fallback model variant to flip to if latency or errors spike — what do we pin?
ash_serving: fallback -> redwood/gpt-large-q4f (quantized) is our recommended option. Lower quality but keeps latency SLOs.
raj_sre: for the run, set autoscale min=8 GPUs, max=32 GPUs. Scale policy: p95 latency >150ms triggers +50% pool scale, errors >1.5% trigger immediate fallback.
emma_eng: load assets are staged: s3://rally/payloads/primeburst-2026-03.json 
emma_eng: load command (to run from perf infra):
```bash
rally run \
  --target 600 \
  --duration 20m \
  --concurrency 400 \
  --payload s3://rally/payloads/primeburst-2026-03.json \
  --warmup 5m
```
marta_cs: perfect. Who's primary oncall for the window?
raj_sre: i'll be primary, @sam_oncall is backup. sam_oncall: i'm available 09:00-11:00 PT and on slack.
marta_cs: ops: can you flip traffic to the reserved pool at 08:50 and then run the priming step at 09:00 before the smoke?
ash_serving: confirmed. We'll prime /v1/generate?model=redwood/gpt-large-q4f with the prefix set; priming will push KV caches for 5m.
marta_cs: product/QA: we need sampling to evaluate quality degradation post-sweep. @liam_pe can you capture 500 sample responses and tag them by prompt id for quick review?
liam_pe: yes. i'll pull the first 500 responses, annotate with prompt_id and latency, upload to drive by 11:00 PT.
marta_cs: final checklist: runbook = https://redwood.internal/runbooks/primeburst, load command executed from perf infra, autoscale policy applied (min 8 / max 32), fallback model pinned, observability dashboard watch and alert threshold set. Everyone good?
ash_serving: :+1:
emma_eng: :thumbsup: I'll kick off the warm cache job at 09:00.
raj_sre: I'll monitor infra, ready to rollback at 09:10 if error rate climbs.
liam_pe: I'll post the sample link once uploaded.
marta_cs: thanks all — moving to go/no-go board. If no blockers by 08:30 PT, we proceed.
all: :rocket:
